headline: Nigeria’s FCMB Group net profit surges 86% on ₦1 trillion revenue
summary: Nigerian financial group FCMB reported an 86% increase in net profit for the nine-month period, driven by a 21% rise in gross earnings to ₦1 trillion and reduced funding costs on interest-bearing liabilities.
why: FCMB Group is a major commercial banking institution listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.why: Net earnings grew 86% driven by revenue expansion to ₦1 trillion.
